prompt: In a TypeScript app, send an add_cart_item command to the owner-scoped cart aggregate at owner/{ownerId}/cart, wait for the snapshot, then read the updated cart state.
expectedBehavior: Imports CommandClient, SnapshotQueryClient, CommandStage, and waitStrategy (or CommandHeaders) from @ahoo-wang/wow-client and Fetcher from @ahoo-wang/fetcher
Binds ownerId through urlParams.path (or a resource-attribution interceptor) instead of hard-coding it into basePath
Waits for CommandStage.SNAPSHOT with waitStrategy({ stage: CommandStage.SNAPSHOT }) (or the CommandHeaders.WAIT_STAGE header) before reading state
Treats a result whose errorCode is not ErrorCodes.SUCCEEDED as a failed command, and reads a refused request with toWowError
Reads state with getStateById (or singleState with filter.aggregateId) using the aggregateId from the CommandResult

prompt: Page PAID orders whose createdAt is yesterday in the Asia/Shanghai zone, 20 per page, newest first, returning only state objects.
expectedBehavior: Builds the filter with filter.and, filter.eq, and filter.yesterday using zoneId 'Asia/Shanghai' rather than hand-written JSON or deprecated Condition helpers
Sorts with desc('state.createdAt') and paginates with pagination { index: 1, size: 20 }
Calls pagedState on a SnapshotQueryClient (or one created from QueryClientFactory)
Imports every builder from @ahoo-wang/wow-client

prompt: This React app depends on @ahoo-wang/fetcher-wow and @ahoo-wang/fetcher-react 5.0 and imports usePagedQuery from the @ahoo-wang/fetcher-react root. Move it to the Wow-owned packages.
expectedBehavior: Replaces @ahoo-wang/fetcher-wow with @ahoo-wang/wow-client in dependencies and every import specifier
Adds @ahoo-wang/wow-react and imports usePagedQuery from it instead of the @ahoo-wang/fetcher-react root
Upgrades @ahoo-wang/fetcher-react to 5.1.5 or later because wow-react imports only its core and fetcher subpaths
Keeps @ahoo-wang/fetcher, @ahoo-wang/fetcher-decorator, and @ahoo-wang/fetcher-eventstream under their existing names and runs the type check

Fixes the call sites the type check reports for APIs changed in the first wow-client release (for example ErrorCodes.isSucceeded, new CommandClient<C>, aggregation builder arguments) and imports any Condition builders from @ahoo-wang/wow-client/legacy

prompt: In a React form built on a generated CartCommandClient, show the server's field validation messages next to the inputs when add_cart_item is refused, and a toast for any other failure.
expectedBehavior: Wraps the command call in try/catch rather than inspecting a returned errorCode: a refused or failed command rejects
Reads the failure with await toWowError(error) and treats undefined as a network, timeout or abort failure
Maps wowError.bindingErrors (name, msg) to the form fields when errorCode is ErrorCodes.COMMAND_VALIDATION
Resends only after no Wow answer and with the same requestId; does not resend after RequestTimeout or DuplicateRequestId

prompt: The Wow order service sits behind CoSec. Wire the browser app so every generated Wow client sends the user's token, fills {ownerId} from the signed-in user, and refreshes the token when it expires.
expectedBehavior: Configures one Fetcher for the service (registered as the default or passed as fetcher) instead of per-call headers
Applies @ahoo-wang/fetcher-cosec's CoSecConfigurer with a CoSecTokenRefresher on a separate Fetcher, and stores the token with tokenStorage.signIn after login
Relies on CoSec's resource attribution to fill {tenantId}/{ownerId} rather than hard-coding them into basePath
Keeps the generated clients' bounded-context prefix unless the app calls the service directly without a gateway

prompt: We must keep calling a Wow 8.10 server from a new frontend that uses @ahoo-wang/wow-client. Query the active carts of one owner.
expectedBehavior: Imports and, eq, ownerId and listQuery from @ahoo-wang/wow-client/legacy because Wow 8.10 understands only the Condition model
Keeps the query clients and everything else imported from the root entry
Avoids getById/getStateById, which send a FilterExpression, and uses single/singleState with a /legacy aggregateId query for one aggregate
Notes that /legacy is removed in v10 and that raw() is refused by servers from 8.11 on
